messages:
alex: Heads-up: code freeze goes live at 22:00 UTC today (cutoff for merges 21:30 UTC). If you need a late merge, post the PR link + short risk summary here and tag @release-council. We'll triage exceptions until 21:50. :bell:

maya: quick q — is the version bump for 1.14.0 automatic from CI or do we need to push the tag?

sam: PR #6129 (runtime: fix kv cache invalidation) — low-risk, 1 flaky windows test, CI green otherwise. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6129

infra-bot: CI status — PR 6129: all checks passed except windows/unit (flaky). Last run: 6m ago. :white_check_mark:

linda: @release-council ping to approve #6129? Has a rollback plan: revert PR and redeploy previous model config.

release-council: Reviewing — can we see a changelog entry and confirm no schema migrations? If both clear, we can allow a late exception with canary + 15-min watch.

sam: changelog dir updated in branch. No schema/migration. Canary plan: route 1% traffic to new runtime for 30m, monitor latency/errors. I'll be on call.

alex: Please include the short changelog blurb in this format so docs automation picks it up:

```
- runtime: fix kv cache invalidation causing token duplication in rare sharding cases (#6129)
```

Also run `scripts/bump-version.sh 1.14.0` if you haven't.

maya: for the version bump — CI will open the tag PR automatically after merge, but you need to run the script locally if you want the tag early.

sam: ack. I'll run bump script and push tag after merge.

deploy-bot: automatic deploys disabled during freeze window. Use `release-council approve-late-merge <pr>` to trigger emergency deploy.

linda: approved for PR #6129. Conditions: changelog included, canary live + 15m stable, rollback ready. :thumbsup:

maya: tiny reminder — update Jira RED-2145 with the canary details and owner.

alex: thanks all. I'll add the exception to the freeze log. If anyone else has late merges, follow the same flow. :eyes:

sam: merged at 21:10 UTC. Canary started (1%). Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood/internal/canaries/6129 — will report back at 21:40.
